description: A GraphQL-driven Swift affordance exists in the UI (artifact preview context menu item that reads payloadAvailabilityState to decide if 'Copy payload path' is available) but has no corresponding row in thin_client_affordance_contract_v1. Without a contract row, the affordance has no named source fields, no disabled reason mapping, no fallback copy, no stale behavior, no unauthorized behavior, and no proof tests.
hold_condition: Every GraphQL-driven Swift affordance must have source fields, local presentation state, disabled/fallback copy, mutation availability, mutation idempotency when applicable, stale behavior, unauthorized behavior, supported interactions, and tests.

missing_affordance_example.affordance_description: Context menu item: Copy payload path
missing_affordance_example.current_status: no p085 contract row exists for this affordance

resolution: Add a contract row to thin_client_affordance_contract_v1 before shipping the affordance. The row must name all source fields, local presentation state, disabled/fallback copy, and proof tests.
